open_prs.title: Add workspace recovery, shared SSH shells and native tmux panes
open_prs.body:
## Why

Terminal workspaces previously depended on manual named arrangements. This continuation adds opt-in automatic recovery of the most recent workspace, with a separate choice to launch fresh local shells. It retains the shared SSH shells, native tmux panes, SSH agents, saved forwarding and output triggers already in this PR.

## Automatic workspace recovery

- **Terminal layout → Session recovery → Remember terminal workspace** saves the current workspace immediately and then debounces structural updates. Recovery and local-shell relaunch both default off.
- The checkpoint preserves up to eight tabs, order/names, nested split topology and proportions, active pane, font sizes, and sanitized SSH/jump/agent/tmux/Screen destinations. Initial recovery finishes before a default shell starts.
- Restored panes remain disconnected. Their ready-state buttons explicitly start a local shell or open the existing SSH authentication dialog. A remembered SSH destination is shown in its idle header.
- **Relaunch local shells** starts fresh local sessions only for tabs without an SSH destination. It uses the existing verified current local folder or fallback; previous commands, working directories and processes are not resumed.
- Passwords, private keys, passphrases, output, history, filesystem grants, staged-workspace authority, broadcast membership and live route ownership are excluded.
- Disable retains the last checkpoint. Confirmed **Forget saved workspace** clears it and resets both preferences while current terminals remain open. Named arrangements stay independent.
- Read failures are bounded and preserve saved bytes. Save failures pause autosaves and expose Retry. A startup-read retry does not overwrite an unseen checkpoint; explicit Save chooses the current workspace. Settings remain closable during accepted writes.
- New recovery copy covers all eight existing non-English locales. The production settings dialog and explicit actions have compact-layout regressions.

### Ownership and race handling

Writes are serialized under an exclusive workspace lease. Acquiring a replacement owner queues the prior owner's final snapshot before the successor loads, including same-frame keyed remounts. Settings and activation snapshots are atomic. Epoch/lease checks reject stale dialogs and completions. An idle queue starts in the caller's scheduler. After a pending write settles, the current layout is checked again so reverting during that write cannot leave the checkpoint stale. Output/focus notifications do not write identical layouts.

[Usage guide](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/terminal.md#automatic-session-recovery) · [Feature coverage](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/terminal-parity.md)

## Earlier terminal work retained

Shared SSH shell tabs and panes use independent terminal channels on the selected authenticated route, with per-owner input, output, resize, exit and broadcast identity. Route forwarding/agent resources outlive any one sibling and close after the final owner. Pending opens, cancellation, late results and cleanup remain bounded.

The default-off native tmux mode maps remote windows and pane geometry to native controls over one verified SSH control route. Earlier SSH-agent authentication/forwarding, credential-free forwarding recipes, output rules, custom keys, search and retained-buffer interaction remain present. Their historical acceptance records keep their original source and platform boundaries.

## Incoming work integrated

The initial fetch contained 40 branch heads and 153 PR heads, all already ancestors of starting source `74fbdd5a`. A later refresh found main `5d3a020d` and PRs #164–#166.

Integration `3ab3323d` incorporates main and preserves all three original PR tips as parents after proving exact tree identity with their squash commits. It retains all 2,409 managed Office entries, including 18 newer Zotero entries absent from the incoming manifest. Canonical Quds source [`be2c3a91`](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite/commit/be2c3a91b0dd5b4abb1b9a7baa8f5e10769bc87a) combines the retained and incoming pins, changing only four ODS files.

All 2,409 host hashes/modes, 552 canonical Quds blobs/modes and 1,857 unchanged standalone-parser blobs/modes pass verification. The fresh 10:06 UTC advertisement contains **43 branches + 156 PR heads = 199 references**; every tip is an actual ancestor of the saved feature branch.

[Integration proof](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/incoming-audit/README.md)

## Current local validation

Frozen implementation source is `3cd50179`. Later checkpoints contain evidence and documentation only. Flutter **3.47.8 / Dart 3.13.7** and the enforced production dependency graph are used.

The first combined isolated Dart/widget run completed with **462 passed, one platform skip and zero failures across 36 files**: 76 recovery/idle-action tests, 267 related terminal tests, 118 incoming Office tests, and one production-widget capture fixture. Its runner reported all 5,664 watched input identities unchanged.

The worker became unavailable immediately afterward. The implementation and earlier evidence were already saved remotely, but the final run's raw log, full inventories and final PNGs had not been copied. [The preserved result](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/recovered-worker/README.md) is explicitly reconstructed from completed tool output. A fresh durable rerun, final 164-file analysis/format check, and full optimized web build are in progress in a restored persistent execution session.

The isolated test mode uses `FLUTTER_NATIVE_ASSETS=false FLUTTER_DART_DATA_ASSETS=true`: the exact production graph and data hooks remain, while unrelated native code assets are omitted. No production manifest, test assertion, hook source or SDK binary is changed for that mode. The original normal-native attempt stopped before test execution because Rust/Cargo was unavailable. These results do not qualify real native bridges, local shell processes, live SSH/tmux, packaged applications or browser execution.

[Complete acceptance record](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/README.md)

## Remaining boundaries

Workspace recovery does not resurrect process memory, output, working directories or authenticated routes. Abrupt termination can lose an unfinished preference write. Native tmux real-daemon acceptance, browser runtime, packaged macOS/Windows, physical devices and external gateways remain separate qualification work.

Independent OS windows, process/scrollback restoration, automatic SSH reconnect, idle connection masters after the final owner closes, cross-process pooling, richer trigger/coprocess automation and broader platform/agent integration remain open. Full iTerm2 parity is unfinished.

**No GitHub Actions were queried, awaited or rerun.** Incremental commits carry `[skip ci]`; remote updates preserve the expected previous branch head.
